summary: Phoenix Asia Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a stock acquisition agreement to acquire all equity of ACEA Pharma, Inc. from ACEA Therapeutics, Inc. Consideration is 100 million newly-issued Phoenix ordinary shares valued at $1,000,000,000, implying $10.00 per share. The board has not disclosed a recommendation or advisor. Closing expected in Q2 2026, subject to HSR antitrust clearance and Nasdaq approval for a reverse merger/change of control. A $20M convertible promissory note was issued to the controlling shareholder for advisory services. Watch for regulatory hurdles and shareholder approval; risk-arb centers on timing and Nasdaq listing conditions.
